Class ConsoleUI

java.lang.Object
chess.console.ConsoleUI
public class ConsoleUI extends Object
Text interface for the game: prints the board, reads commands, and forwards moves to Game.

All console input and output lives in this class. Streams are injected through the constructor, so the UI can be driven from a file or a string for testing instead of the keyboard.
